title.en: How Artificial Intelligence Can Revolitionise Science
title.zh: 人工智能如何能够给科学带来革命性的改变

sentences.en: Debate about artificial itelligence tends to focus on its potential dangers:
sentences.zh: 有关人工智能的辩论通常倾向于聚焦在它的潜在危害上：

sentences.en: algorithmic bias and discrimination, the mass destruction of jobs and even, some say, the extinction of humanity.
sentences.zh: 算法偏见与歧视、大规模摧毁结业岗位，甚至还有一些人提到的人类灭亡。
